dedupe_keys.name: implementing neural network based equalizers in a coherent optical transmission system using field programmable gate arrays

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The documented pipeline converts Python neural-network models into FPGA implementations for coherent optical equalisation. It evaluates biLSTM+CNN and CNN designs against one-step-per-span DBP using simulated and experimental 34-GBd dual-polarisation 16QAM transmission over 17 spans of 70 km LEAF fibre. Coverage includes activation-function approximations and fixed-point designs for 200G and 400G throughput. An experimental Q-factor gain is reported for the stated baseline. The paper does not establish public HDL or synthesis-project availability. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
